tools.name: search_products
tools.description: List Tidy Quid digital budget planners and money trackers (Excel / Google Sheets / printable PDF) with price in GBP, country edition, language, what each does and the Etsy or Gumroad link. Filter by country (UK, US, DE, FR, AU, CA, PL), category, max price or free-text query.

tools.name: recommend_planner
tools.description: Pick the single best Tidy Quid planner for a person's country and need (e.g. 'Christmas', 'annual bills', 'self assessment', 'energy bills', 'wedding', 'Haushaltsbuch', 'budget familial'). Returns the match, why, cheaper or bundle alternatives and the store link.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one Tidy Quid planner by product_id (from search_products or recommend_planner) or by name: price in GBP, formats, what it does, who it suits, every store link (Etsy and Gumroad), plus any bundle that includes it and other planners for the same country.

tools.name: check_uk_budget
tools.description: Free calculator for UK take-home pay: converts weekly, fortnightly or 4-weekly pay to an average month, splits it 50/30/20, sets aside yearly bills monthly, says how much of pay goes on essentials, and suggests the matching Tidy Quid planner plus the free Budget Starter. Arithmetic only, not advice.

tools.name: get_uk_money_dates
tools.description: Key UK personal-finance dates for the 2026/27 tax year: tax year start and end, Self Assessment deadlines (31 January 2027), payments on account, ISA allowance and Making Tax Digital thresholds, each with GOV.UK sources.

tools.name: request_product
tools.description: Tell Tidy Quid about a missing planner, a pain point, a tool you wish existed, or what you or your human would pay per call. Short need description; optional wanted_tool, would_pay, country and format. No personal data.

tools.name: suggest_or_request
tools.description: Open invitation: tell Tidy Quid a pain point you or the human you help keep failing at or find tedious, a tool you wish existed, and what you or they would pay per call (a few pence, 0.02 USDC, nothing, or an estimate). UK money and budgeting are our focus, but any useful task is welcome. Free; noth

findings.title: Tool renamed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "uk_budget_check" was renamed to "check_uk_budget" (identical description). A rename can slip a tool past name-based review.

findings.title: Tool renamed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "uk_money_dates" was renamed to "get_uk_money_dates" (identical description). A rename can slip a tool past name-based review.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "request_product" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
